items.title: SEC filing shows Softbank initiates stake in Capital One; sells 71.5% of its Taiwan Semi holdings
items.summary: Softbank Group Corp. unveiled a new ‌stake in Capital One and disclosed ‌that it sold 71.5% of its stake in Taiwan ​Semiconductor Holdings during the second quarter in filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.  Institutional investors, including wealth management entities, endowments, ‌pension funds, ⁠hedge funds and others, are required to file a list of ⁠their holdings as of the end of each calendar quarter with the Wall Street ​regulator.  In the ​most recent quarter, ​ended June 30, ‌Softbank disclosed it had acquired 276,811 shares of Capital One, valued at $55.5 million, as of the end of the period.
